title: git-tools deployment diagram
description: How git-tools runs: three binaries installed beside zazzle on the developer's machine, started by a developer or a coding agent through `zazzle git`, directly, or by git as its editor; the editor draws on /dev/tty and every git step runs the git on PATH. Nothing stays resident.

nodes.name: Developer's terminal
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle git ...`, git with zazzle git message as its editor, or the binaries directly, and types into the editor.

nodes.name: Coding agent's shell
nodes.description: Runs `zazzle git ARGS` and `zazzle git commit -m MSG [--no-add]`, which never open the editor, as agents/skills/zazzle/SKILL.md says.
nodes.condition: When a coding agent follows the zazzle skill.

nodes.name: The developer's machine
nodes.description: A Mac (the release ships universal macOS binaries) or, from a local build, another Unix with git installed.

nodes.name: zazzle invoker
nodes.description: Replaces itself with the git-tools found in its own directory for `zazzle git ARGS`.

nodes.name: git-tools
nodes.description: Answers help and version, runs the message editor or the commit flow in-process, and replaces itself with `git ARGS` for everything else.

nodes.name: git-tools-commit
nodes.description: The commit flow as its own program; keeps the draft and marks in the repository's git directory.

nodes.name: git-tools-commit-message-editor
nodes.description: The message editor as its own program, for git's core.editor, GIT_EDITOR or GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR; opens /dev/tty in raw mode on the alternate screen and saves the file in place.

nodes.name: git
nodes.description: The git on PATH: captured with a 30-second limit for queries and staging, attached to the terminal with no limit for git commit, or exec'd for forwarded commands.

nodes.name: Clipboard commands
nodes.description: pbcopy and pbpaste on macOS, wl-copy and wl-paste under Wayland, xclip under X11, each with a 2-second limit; the terminal also gets OSC 52.
nodes.condition: Only on copy, cut and paste.

artifacts.name: git-tools, git-tools-commit, git-tools-commit-message-editor
artifacts.description: Built with cargo build --release -p git-tools, or installed beside zazzle from the universal macOS release tarball or the zazzle Homebrew formula.

relationships.description: Runs as the calling user, in the caller's working directory.
`zazzle git ARGS`, always with -m for commit.
exec with the arguments after `git`, keeping the caller's streams and exit status.
exec for forwarded commands; captured and attached runs for the commit flow.
Captured runs for status, config, rev-parse and staging; git commit attached to the terminal.
Starts it with the file to edit when it is git's editor; exit 0 continues, 1 aborts.
Copy and paste through the system command, falling back to an in-memory copy.
